services.desc: Birthday parties are supposed to be fun - but for parents they can also involve hours of planning and assembling decorations, the upheaval creating confusion and leaving icing on the carpet afterward. It’s why so many New York City families find themselves swapping at-home birthday parties for memorable experiences - and one of the best parties ever is taking your child to a live magic show right in the heart of Manhattan. And if you’re hoping to guarantee your child has a great day, then the Broadway Magic Hour will do the job: laughter, surprise, audience engagement, and memories to cherish long after the candles have been blown out. This live stage show runs on weekend afternoons at 2PM
